|desc={{p|Darkrai}} is Tobias's main Pokémon. Using only Darkrai, Tobias easily won eight [[Badge]]s in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]] and quickly advanced through the first four rounds of the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. Darkrai was first seen defeating a Trainer's {{p|Machamp}} in the first round.

In ''[[DP189|The Semi-Final Frontier!]]'', Darkrai faced {{Ash}} and his Pokémon in the semi-finals of the tournament. It managed to defeat his {{AP|Heracross}}, {{AP|Torkoal}}, and {{AP|Gible}} with ease, before finally meeting its match in [[Ash's Sceptile]]. In the finals, Darkrai defeated Tobias's opponent's entire team, making him the winner of the tournament.

Darkrai's known moves are {{m|Ice Beam}}, {{m|Dark Void}}, {{m|Dream Eater}}, and {{m|Dark Pulse}}.}}
